description:
Empo plays RPG Maker XP, VX, and VX Ace games, and Pokemon SDK games, on iPhone and iPad. Import a game from Files, as a folder or an archive, and play it with touch controls or a game controller.

FOUR RUBY VERSIONS IN ONE APP
Empo includes Ruby 1.8, 1.9, and 3.1 for RPG Maker games, and Ruby 3.0 for Pokemon SDK games. Each game runs on the version it was written for, so classic titles and modern engine forks both work.

IMPORT
• RPG Maker games with the standard Data layout
• Pokemon SDK game folders
• .zip, .7z, and .rar archives
• Self-extracting installers
• Empo detects the engine and runs the matching Ruby
• Artwork comes from the game's own icon when there is one

PLAY
• On-screen D-pad and action buttons you can move and resize
• Separate layouts per game and per orientation
• Bluetooth and MFi game controllers
• Pause and resume from the library
• Local multiplayer for games that support it

LIBRARY
• Sort, search, grid and list views
• Per-game settings
• Save files survive re-imports and game updates

FREE AND OPEN SOURCE
Empo is free. There is no subscription, no unlock, and no ads. It collects no data. The source code is on GitHub under GPLv2+.

IMPORTANT
Empo is a game player. It does not include, sell, host, or download games. Import only games you have the right to play.

Support: https://github.com/mateo-m/empo-app/issues
